hints.tr: Bir önceki alanı bir değişkende tut (`holder`); her teslimden sonra `holder = taker`.
hints.en: Keep the previous taker in a variable (`holder`); after every handover `holder = taker`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def custody_gaps(entries):
    gaps = []
    holder = None
    for time, giver, taker in entries:
        if holder is not None and giver != holder:
            gaps.append(time)
        holder = taker
    return gaps

CUSTODY = [
    ["02:40", "ada", "locker"],
    ["09:15", "locker", "eve"],
    ["17:00", "joe", "locker"],
    ["18:30", "locker", "eve"],
    ["19:00", "bob", "locker"],
]
print(custody_gaps(CUSTODY))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def custody_gaps(entries):
    gaps = []
    holder = None
    for time, giver, taker in entries:
        if holder is not None and giver != holder:
            gaps.append(time)
        holder = taker
    return gaps

CUSTODY = [
    ["02:40", "ada", "locker"],
    ["09:15", "locker", "eve"],
    ["17:00", "joe", "locker"],
    ["18:30", "locker", "eve"],
    ["19:00", "bob", "locker"],
]
print(custody_gaps(CUSTODY))
```
